TWC Local Forecast (Mt. Holly, NJ) - 6/17/2009 - 5:28am ET
recentItems.description:
I believe this day was when the overnight playlist was extended from 5am to 6am ET which would remain this way until 2012.  The previous two LFs aired daytime songs, while this and the remaining ones this hour aired overnight tracks.  This LF is the overnight cut of the song and not the later cut used briefly in the daytime playlist at the beginning of the month.

Song:  Heat Death of the Universe - Fila Brazilia
